description:
Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests missing CSRF tokens indicating potential cross-site request forgery

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_015", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cross%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%site%') AND "value" > 0
